details_of_achievements.achievement: 722 women farmers engaged in diversified income generation activity cultivating 6 to 7 varieties of crops each season.419 children and mothers reached through nutritional improvement activities and anthropometric measurement. 1000 farmers engaged in sericulture and handloom activity. 400 farmers engaged in land restoration and improved land practices through intercropping indigenous nutritious homestead gardening.155 wadi farmers engaged in weaving and entrepreneurial activity.
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Strong grassroot engagement and participation from the community. Building collective groups and creating a model. Empowering and capacity building of women leaders and vulnerable community for sustainable change. Convergence with the government and other agency to access to entitlement and resource support. Networking and capacity building with civil society to strengthen advocacy and share knowledge. Process documentation, research and building strategy to reflect impact and plan for future.

details_of_achievements.achievement: 239 school children and 534 youth engaging in bodo cultural dance sessions weekly. 182 bodo musical instrument and mementos produced. Annual cultural sifung festival organised yearly 1000 youth and children participating in dance, music stall exchange and other cultural activities. Eri farming with 5 groups for cultural preservation and promotion.
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Engaging with youth and children in preserving cultural heritage to ensures values, skills and knowledge are preserved and passed on to next generation. Documentation of folklores through research and video documentation. Building local artists and artisans to represent in local and regional platform to promote bodo culture and also resource person for the youth and children.

details_of_achievements.achievement: 18 forest learning centre operational,729 children enrolled and attending classes. Annual Aser assessment conducted to measure learning competencies of the children.53 percent of the children in class 3 to 5 can read whole sentences fluently.69 percent of the children in class 3 to 5 can write dictated sentences.
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Capacity building of the local teachers for sustainability. Engagement with parents and community. Partnership with other agency for resource and technical support. Livelihood initiatives with the community for self functioning of the forest learning centres.

details_of_achievements.achievement: 14263 patients registered. 50 children with developmental disorder screened and provided physiotherapy and counselling.Provided low cost quality mental health services to 15 partners
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Alliance with NGOs partners providing capacity building and technical support. patient centric providing low cost quality mental health services. Ethics and program centric protocol based on WHO mh GAP NICE standards. Mobile app web based system to record and enforce treatment protocols

details_of_achievements.achievement: Published annual reports, brochures and newsletter periodically.Document and published 7 documentaries in organisation social media platform, share with partners and community for educational and educational purpose.Published 2 podcast on mental health and women health and gender.
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Adapting and upgrading technology for organisational visibility. Research and documenting folklores and cultures for educational purpose and archive for reference.Engaging with programs, donors and community through digital content.

details_of_achievements.achievement: 419 children aged 0 to 5 reached through nutritional improvement sessions, monthly follow up and anthropometric measurement to monitor malnutrition status.522 women of the reproductive age group reached through anemia reduction intervention through nutritional training and support.
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Building community cadres as resource person to monitor and conduct session on nutrition and data collection. Colloboration with ASHA and Anganwadi. Livelihood support for additional income and promotion of kitchen garden.

details_of_achievements.achievement: 1243 children and youth from different community engaging in weekly ultimate frisbee sessions.38 ultimate frisbee team captain, 52 spirit captain and coaches trained and functional. Annual coach forum organized every year with 91 coaches attending the forum. Regional ultimate frisbee tournament with players from different state.
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Engaging with youth from different community and gender to promote gender equity and peacful co existence. Integrating career guidance program during sports session to improved educational and employment aspiration. Networking with sport department and other agency for support and coordination. Documentation and sharing inspirational stories through videos, pictures with the community and partners. Social media to promote ultimate frisbee and sports for overall development.

details_of_achievements.achievement: 1325 women and men reached through awareness meeting and sessions on domestic violence. 148 response groups formed and functional with 740 members as first responder at village level to act against domestic violence. 341 key leaders involved in trainings and programs. Weekly legal aid camp organized and engaging with 161 domestic violence survivors
details_of_achievements.best_practices: Capacity building of Response Group as the first responder to act against domestic violence. Engaging with key leaders and civil society building capacity and to take responsibility. Lending legal support through legal weekly camps for legal consultation. Collaboration with government agency police and other agency to act against domestic violence
